native_behavior: Page mentions create backlinks for navigation
semester_mapping: Page -> mentions -> page; expose incoming edges as permission-filtered backlinks
migration_method: Authorized export or supported connector; preserve source page IDs and link targets
loss_or_risk: Unresolved source links; backlink is not an academic requirement
reconciliation: Every permitted explicit link resolves or enters exception queue

native_behavior: Relations connect database pages; rollups aggregate related properties
semester_mapping: Named relation -> reviewed typed edge; rollup -> derived fact with rule and input lineage
migration_method: Preserve relation properties/target identifiers and calculation definition separately from flat snapshots
loss_or_risk: CSV relation values do not automatically recreate relational behavior; static values are not live formulas
reconciliation: Compare relation endpoints/cardinality and recomputed outputs; mark unsupported behavior
best_fit: Course/task/resource databases with structured shared views

native_behavior: Page and database exports provide portable content snapshots
semester_mapping: Student-owned imported content stays private/unverified unless separately authorized
migration_method: Preview authorized scope; stage Markdown/HTML/CSV and attachments; retain source manifest
loss_or_risk: History, permissions, views and automations require separate parity assessment
reconciliation: Validate content, attachments, IDs, link mapping and permission intent
best_fit: Selective personal-workspace migration, not official academic rule import

native_behavior: Graph visualizes internal note links; backlinks distinguish linked and unlinked mentions
semester_mapping: Explicit internal links -> mentions/related_to edges; unlinked mentions -> suggestions only
migration_method: Copy selected vault notes/attachments; resolve path, alias, heading and block links
loss_or_risk: Ambiguous filenames or unresolved aliases; inferred mentions must not become confirmed edges
reconciliation: Resolve all explicit links or list exceptions; recompute incoming backlinks rather than import duplicates
best_fit: Personal exploratory knowledge and linked research notes

native_behavior: Markdown note links and metadata do not by themselves enforce institutional rule semantics
semester_mapping: Reviewed metadata -> typed fields/edges; preserve unknown properties without inventing meaning
migration_method: Map declared frontmatter conventions and stable note identifiers; review plugin-specific semantics
loss_or_risk: Plugin-derived calculations or views require explicit mapping; plain link lacks prerequisite timing/grade policy
reconciliation: Validate types, target IDs and calculation inputs; leave unknown mappings pending review
best_fit: Flexible personal schema, with Semester supplying governed academic semantics

native_behavior: Notes are Markdown plain-text files in a local vault
semester_mapping: Owned resource nodes with portable original files and private scope
migration_method: Import selected files; exclude credentials/configuration/plugin code unless separately reviewed
loss_or_risk: Local storage alone does not prove encrypted or policy-compliant handling; attachments may contain protected data
reconciliation: Compare file hashes and paths; maintain export map; classify before AI retrieval
best_fit: Local-file control, offline notes and Markdown portability

native_behavior: Drive files and document URLs provide resource references
semester_mapping: Source file -> resource node; extracted links -> reviewed mentions; course mapping is explicit
migration_method: Link-first scoped integration or permitted selected exports
loss_or_risk: Do not assume native file links encode prerequisites or a complete semantic graph
reconciliation: Verify source file ID/version, rights and explicit relationship meaning
best_fit: Keep collaborative authoring while Semester provides academic context

native_behavior: My Drive transfers are constrained; shared-drive files belong to the organization
semester_mapping: Institution-controlled source scope or student-owned source scope; grants cannot broaden source rights
migration_method: Respect original ownership; obtain organization authority for shared-drive migration
loss_or_risk: Visibility is not ownership or redistribution permission; inherited folder access must be checked
reconciliation: Validate source access, intended recipient scope, revocations and copy rights

native_behavior: Collaborative files remain in native authoring tools unless separately exported
semester_mapping: Link resource first; migrated copies are distinct versions with explicit conversion provenance
migration_method: Export permitted chosen formats; separately inventory formulas, comments/history and dependencies
loss_or_risk: Copy/export does not automatically reproduce collaborative editing or spreadsheet semantics
reconciliation: Check bytes/conversion, formulas and linked dependencies where needed; retain source for unsupported workflows
best_fit: Hybrid integration rather than forced editor replacement
